title: Roaming presenter field notes and expense capture
body:
Quick context
- Running 2x 25m talks, 1x 90m hands-on workshop (limited to 20) at DevRel Roadshow. Mostly east-coast, 3-city run. Goal: low-friction set-up + clean expense capture for finance.

Top priorities before travel
- Confirm hotel early check-in with front desk (call 24h before). If no early check-in: drop bag at concierge + grab venue storage.
- Print 10 physical speaker bios and 20 workshop handouts (local print shop fallback).
- Charge all batteries 1 night before departure; pack universal travel adapter + two USB-C power bricks (label chargers with red tape).

Expense capture rules (finance friendly)
- Use company card for all vendor payments where possible. If using personal card, snap receipts immediately and upload to Expensify with expense code DEVREL-TRAVEL.
- Meals: per-diem allowed up to $75/day US metro. For larger group meals, create one expense and add attendees list in note.
- Taxis/Rideshares: prefer rideshare and use company card. If reimbursing personal use (rare), include trip photo + invoice and approximate route.
- Printing/Materials: tag as 'event-materials' and attach invoice.
- Local vendor payments: get emailed invoice (not just cash receipt) when > $50 — this speeds AP.

Receipts quick workflow (to self)
1) Immediately photograph receipt (phone) in natural light, crop to show total and vendor.
2) Add short note: city/date/purpose (e.g., "Boston lunch w/ venue ops 2024-11-14").
3) Upload to expense tracker within 48h. If you forget, put all receipts in a single envelope labeled city/date and email finance.

Venue / day-of logistics (checklist)
- AV run-of-show: arrive 90 minutes before talk. Check mic (lapel + handheld), projector resolution, HDMI + USB-C adapter, speaker notes on Presenter laptop AND backup on USB thumbdrive.
- Wi‑Fi: request guest network + temporary VLAN for workshop attendees. If Wi‑Fi flaky, have offline copies of workshop assets and local hotspot (phone) as fallback.
- Booth/table: 6ft table, tablecloth, two chairs, A-frame sign. Confirm table location 48h out.
- Vendor contact: onsite liaison is usually the venue operations lead — get direct cell.

Vendor contacts (local print / AV / catering)
- Citywide Print Co. — contact: Leo Ramos, leo@cityprint.example, +1-617-555-0143 (same-day turnaround for 50 copies).
- QuickAV — contact: Priyanka Shah, pri@quickav.example, +1-415-555-0128 (bring small ladder for hanging signs).
- Neighborhood Cafe (catering small breakfasts) — contact: Omar, orders@nbcafe.example, +1-646-555-0199 (deliver 30m before room opens).

Packing note (non-obvious)
- Small extension cord + power strip (not provided usually).
- Duct tape (for signage), velcro cable ties, gaffer tape (don’t use duct on floors), and small scissors.
- Printed spare slide deck page with speaker notes for moderator.
- Hand sanitizer + allergy meds (Benadryl).

Reimbursements: common gotchas
- Uber receipts sometimes show only driver name; pull ride summary and copy timestamp & route. Finance prefers transaction + ride summary.
- When meals are covered by sponsor, still collect itemized bill and highlight items Redwood paid for.
- Currency conversions: save bank exchange rate screenshot or use XE.com screenshot for manual expenses.

Communications and escalation
- For emergency logistics day-of (venue no-show, lost props): ping #devrel-oncall then page Sasha Li (cell: +1-555-0104). Use Slack thread then follow-up with email summary for finance if money changed hands.
- If vendor won't email invoice, capture a picture of the signed receipt and include company tax id in the note.

Open questions / TODOs (action items)
- Jordan: confirm 2x workshop laptops availability by 2024-10-20.
- Sasha: book local print shop window for handouts + 2 signs by 2024-10-22.
- Maya: finalize attendee list for workshop (cap 20) and send confirmation email 2 weeks out.
- Finance: verify if company card can prepay small vendor deposits (TBD). Linked ticket: JIRA-DEVREL-1723.

Notes to self (messy)
- Use the smaller microphone pack when doing workshop demos — less interference.
- Remember to collect business cards (or scan with CamCard) from booth leads; sometimes they handwrite and the scans are trashy, so photo + transcribe.
- Bring small stack of sticker badges (Redwood logo) for booth giveaway.

Post-event wrap (reimbursement sprint)
- Within 5 business days: finalize receipts, upload all to Expensify, mark expenses with city tag and event name.
- In expense notes, link to confluence summary + list of attendees for meal expenses.
- Small honoraria/hotel incidentals: route through my manager for approval before submitting if > $150.

Archived checklist (copy/paste for next run)
- Pre-travel: confirm flights, hotel, early check-in OK, print fallback, speaker bios, batteries charged.
- Day-of: AV check, Wi‑Fi verified, backup materials, vendor cell numbers saved, receipts captured.
- Post-event: receipts uploaded, expense code added, confluence recap + follow-ups scheduled.

End of notes — keep this doc as the single source for event receipts + ad-hoc vendor numbers. Will copy cleaned summary to Confluence after wrap.

-- Maya
